author: anon-df5e95db
content: Depends on: bcf_unpack (done), bcf_update_info (CL-50), bcf_update_format (CL-51), bcf_hdr_id2int (done). 220-line C function — the most complex BCF manipulation function. Rewrites every INFO and FORMAT field to remove references to deleted alleles, updates genotype indices, and rebuilds the shared/indiv binary blocks. Should be one of the last BCF functions replaced.
